settings.heading: Drawing numbers and dimensions
settings.text: Our custom axle blanks with stud patterns, flange details and dimensions. Lengths are given for the L (long), M (medium) and S (short) sides. Search by name, drawing number or spline count.
settings.diagram_caption: Dimension reference for the table below
settings.legend: All dimensions in mm. Ø is diameter. SP is spline count. PCD is pitch circle diameter. D is machining feed rate. If your axle is not listed, send the details and we can most likely make it.

settings.heading: Need an axle made?
settings.text: Send the vehicle, housing, stud pattern, spline count and length required and we will price it up.
